opening.argument: This offer is built around asserted arbitrage returns and a layered referral scheme. The speaker says users can delegate arbitrage for “about 6% to 18% of the monthly profit allocation to your wallet,” while presenting Intelligent Dog as receiving a share of arbitrage profit. It further promises income from the second through tenth layers—“you can still take 10% of their smart gains”—and calculates Bitcoin income across referral layers. Viewers are invited to register through an app link and code and to share friends’ bitcoin entrustment. These are presented claims, not verified returns or completed transfers. Although users are told to keep their private key, the claimed Samsung-related affiliation remains unverified.
